def comps2(g, v=0):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==v or seen[r][c]: continue
            st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; comp=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]!=v and not seen[x][y]:
                        seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
            res.append(comp)
    return res

def solve(g, verbose=False):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for comp in comps2(g, 8):
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        mr,mc=min(rs),min(cs); M,N=max(rs),max(cs)
        R,C=M-mr+1,N-mc+1
        pts=[(i-min(rs), j-min(cs)) for i in range(mr,M+1) for j in range(mc,N+1) if g[i][j]!=0]
        ph=max(p[0] for p in pts)+1 if pts else 1
        pw=max(p[1] for p in pts)+1 if pts else 1
        pat=[[g[mr+i][mc+j] for j in range(C)] for i in range(R)]
        # minimal consistent period over nonzero cells
        per=[(p,C) for p in range(1,R+1) if all(pat[i][j]==pat[i%p][j] for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if g[mr+i][mc+j]!=0)]
        best=min(per,key=lambda t:t[0]) if per else (R,C)
        pr,pw=best
        new=[[pat[i%pr][j%pw] for j in range(C)] for i in range(R)]
        for i in range(mr,mr+R):
            for j in range(mc,mc+C):
                out[i][j]=new[(i-mr)%pr][(j-mc)%pw]
    return out

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==8 or seen[r][c]: continue
            st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; comp=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]!=8 and not seen[x][y]:
                        seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            mr,mc=min(rs),min(cs); M,N=max(rs),max(cs)
            R=C_=M-mr+1; C=N-mc+1
            # pattern: nonzero cells only; crop empty border rows/cols
            keep_r=[i for i in range(R) if any(g[mr+i][mc+j]!=0 for j in range(C))]
            keep_c=[j for j in range(C) if any(g[mr+i][mc+j]!=0 for i in range(R))]
            pat=[[g[mr+i][mc+j] for j in keep_c] for i in keep_r]
            ph=len(pat); pw=len(pat[0])
            for i in range(mr,M+1):
                for j in range(mc,N+1):
                    out[i][j]=pat[(i-mr)%ph][(j-mc)%pw]
    return out
